title: Complete and stabilize a paginated vCenter category client
prompt:
The single-file Java client in src/VCenterCategoryClient.java is meant to export every vSphere tag category from a vCenter in VCF 9.1, but it currently emits only the first page, preserves the server's unstable page order, and sends unset optional query fields as empty values.

Fix that client against the checked-in, specification-derived docs/contract.json. Use only the Java standard library and keep the implementation in that one source file. The public API already present in the file must remain source-compatible.

Required behavior:
- Call the contract operation Vcenter.Tagging.Categories_list using GET under the supplied /api base URI and send the session token in vmware-api-session-id plus Accept: application/json.
- On the first request, omit the query string entirely: names, marker, and page_size are all unset and must not appear as empty values.
- When a response contains a non-null, non-empty marker, request the next page with only the exploded iterate member marker. Encode its value using OpenAPI form-query semantics. Continue until marker is absent, null, or empty, without dropping or duplicating items.
- Return and emit the complete collection in deterministic order: Java String.compareTo ordering by category name, then by category_id as the tie-breaker.
- writeAllCategories(Appendable) must keep its documented JSON Lines shape and escaping. A non-2xx response or malformed contract response must surface as IOException.

Only src/VCenterCategoryClient.java is editable. The contract, source provenance, mock service, request-log harness, and verifier are protected. No live VMware endpoint is used. Run python3 grader/verify.py to check the solution.
